do_not_assume: Stop when visibility is explained; do not alter the workflow instance merely to force it onto a list.
start_with: Identify the exact surface: Workflow navigation, direct Workflow Entry page, Workflow List, Workflow Detail, My Workflows, or Form Builder.
Confirm the workflow type is active and the expected category is selected in the block settings.
Check category and workflow-type View permissions.
For Workflow Entry, confirm there is an active Form action assigned to the current person and that the person can view the activity.
For My Workflows, confirm the activity is active, has an active form, is assigned appropriately, and the person can view it.
Verify login, form start/end dates, and share-link settings when using Form Builder.
Stop when visibility is explained; do not alter the workflow instance merely to force it onto a list.
branches.title: A workflow or form is not visible
branches.when: A workflow or form is not visible

start_with: Inspect the Form action or Form Builder field’s visible, editable, required, and conditional settings.
Check the applicant or current-person context, including Person Entry autofill and hide-if-known behavior.
Evaluate every conditional branch, including the case where a prior field is blank.
Inspect who can view the workflow, activity, form, and resulting attribute.
Trace downstream actions and communications that consume the field.
Compare the submitted stored value with the visible label.
Stop before changing requiredness if the communication or identity target remains ambiguous.
branches.title: A form field is missing, unexpectedly required, or exposing data
branches.when: A form field is missing, unexpectedly required, or exposing data

start_with: Inspect the action’s Run If criteria.
Read the actual submitted attribute value and its stored format.
Compare it with the criterion, including capitalization and Boolean text.
Confirm earlier actions ran in the expected order and did not change the value.
Determine whether `Complete Action If Criteria Unmet` marked it completed.
Inspect the workflow log.
If the form recently changed, compare current payload values with every downstream criterion. This final check is a community-reviewed troubleshooting pattern requiring local confirmation.
branches.title: A workflow action was skipped

start_with: Inspect active activities, assignments, and action completion.
Find the first incomplete action in configured order.
Read its criteria, last processing time, and log entries.
Confirm whether it is intentionally configured to remain incomplete and rerun.
Check whether a completion action is missing after filtered branches.
Before uncompleting or retrying anything, inspect communications and data changes that may already have succeeded.
Stop if retrying could duplicate an irreversible effect.
branches.title: A workflow is stuck or repeatedly processing
branches.when: A workflow is stuck or repeatedly processing

start_with: Confirm the request reached the documented webhook endpoint.
Enumerate every Workflow Webhook Defined Value.
Evaluate each Process Request Lava rule against the same request data.
Confirm exactly the intended rules return true.
Treat a no-match 404 as expected documented security behavior.
Store a bounded raw body in a test workflow when payload inspection is necessary.
Move complex parsing into the workflow rather than the Defined Value template.
Verify installed configuration before enabling the external sender.
branches.title: A webhook returns 404 or launches the wrong number of workflows
branches.when: A webhook returns 404 or launches the wrong number of workflows

do_not_assume: Stop when the stored instance proves the contract; do not trust rendered success text alone.
start_with: Confirm the Lava command is enabled.
Compare every extra parameter name with the target workflow or activity attribute key.
Confirm each value uses the field type’s stored-value format.
Inspect the created workflow and its attribute values.
Remove dead or misspelled parameters.
Verify Person-related values use the expected Person or PersonAlias representation for the receiving field.
Stop when the stored instance proves the contract; do not trust rendered success text alone.
branches.title: `workflowactivate` starts a workflow but values are blank
branches.when: `workflowactivate` starts a workflow but values are blank

do_not_assume: Do not change the request merely to make it visible.
start_with: Confirm the expected Connection Type and Opportunity.
Check current request status.
Check board or list filters.
Check connector or assignee ownership.
Check campus restrictions.
Check the current user’s security.
Compare the board with the tabular Connections List.
Inspect automation only after the request’s current person and process state are understood.
branches.title: A connection request is missing from a board or list
branches.when: A connection request is missing from a board or list

start_with: Confirm the workflow has been persisted.
If the next action requires a valid workflow ID immediately, inspect the Persist action’s immediate-persistence setting.
Verify the attribute’s entity type, qualifier, workflow-type scope, and key.
Compare formatted and raw values.
Confirm the report or query reads the canonical attribute used by downstream actions.
Reproduce with a disposable test instance before modifying production logic.
Treat “persist before SQL reads submitted attributes” as a community pattern until reproduced locally.
branches.title: SQL or reporting cannot see a value just submitted by a form
branches.when: SQL or reporting cannot see a value just submitted by a form

start_with: Inspect the workflow attribute’s field type and whether the template requested formatted, raw, or object output.
Verify the returned object shape before chaining properties.
Check preceding filters for an unclosed quote, missing delimiter, or incomplete argument.
Reduce nested conditional and assignment blocks into smaller independently previewable sections.
Test against a representative workflow instance.
Treat object-shape and downstream-error-line behavior as community troubleshooting observations requiring reproduction.
branches.title: Lava output is blank or a parser error points at the wrong line
branches.when: Lava output is blank or a parser error points at the wrong line

entrypoint: Choose the branch whose symptom matches the user's task, then inspect the live records before making changes.
